To: michael_grant@redwood.io
Date: Sun, 5 Mar 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + 60m co-sell demo for Aurum Analytics?

Hi Michael,

Hope you had a great week. Aurum Analytics (Emily Torres) has been evaluating inference runtimes for their SaaS search stack and asked if CloudWave and Redwood could do a joint product demo focused on marketplace listing and integration patterns. They want to see stack-level performance (latency/cost) and a short ops run-through for the marketplace onboarding checklist.

Proposed slots next week:
- Tue 3/7 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue 3/7 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 3/8 09:00–10:00 PT

If one of those works, we can lock a 60m slot. I can bring CloudWave SI (technical lead + solutions engineer). Emily is looping, cc'd.

Thanks,
Carl Jensen
Partnerships, CloudWave Systems

Carl / Emily,

Thanks — appreciate the context. All sounds good. I can do Tue 3/7 10:00–11:00 PT. Proposed agenda (attached): 1) 10m intros & use case, 2) 25m demo (Redwood runtime + CloudWave SI integration), 3) 15m ops/runbook & marketplace checklist, 4) 10m Q&A / next steps.

Vanessa, Priyom — can you join the ops and marketplace sections? Vanessa for listing logistics / packaging, Priyom for SI enablement notes. If we need to shift to the afternoon, flag now.

I attached a short agenda (Redwood-CloudWave-Aurum-Agenda-v2.pdf). Also linking a working checklist I'll update: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bAgendaLink

Vanessa / Priyom,

Forwarding Carl's request + my proposed 10am PT slot. Two asks:
- Vanessa: can you cover the marketplace listing steps (packaging, metadata, billing SKU mapping) during the ops section? I put a short checklist in the Drive link.
- Priyom: can you prepare a quick SI enablement note (installer/quantization recommendations + runtime knobs we recommend for Aurum's search throughput)?

Also note Aurum is evaluating for a production rollout in Q2, so any notes on lead times for Dedicated vs Hosted would be useful to surface.

FYI: I'll send a calendar invite if Tue 10:00 works for everyone.

Thanks,
Michael
